cards.definition_principle: A candle name is not a setup; the bars and structure around it determine what can be measured.
measurable_predicates: The claim is compiled into versioned numerical predicates.
required_evidence: canonical completed candles or authoritative option snapshot
valid_conditions: All cited inputs are complete, current, and time-safe.
failure_conditions: Required deterministic evidence is missing or stale.
contradictions: The principle does not establish a CITADEL probability.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as standalone direction, probability, risk, or execution authorization.
cards.exact_locator: Opening overview > context over candle patterns
cards.paraphrase: A candle name is not a setup; the bars and structure around it determine what can be measured.
